classification.difficultyReason: Read column frequencies, find their total, convert each proportion to a sector angle and construct a labelled pie chart using the taught procedure.

content.prompt: Display the data shown in the following column graph using a pie chart.

spec.description: Six categorical columns with slanted category labels, numbered vertical ticks every 2 and gridlines every 1. Source decorative category hues are mapped to the standard palette.
spec.mathematics: Violin 8, Cello 5, Drums 1, Clarinet 3, Saxophone 2, Xylophone 1; vertical range 0–10.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied frequencies remain visible; no pie-chart answer is shown.

answer.short:
Sector angles: Violin $144^\circ$; Cello $90^\circ$; Drums $18^\circ$; Clarinet $54^\circ$; Saxophone $36^\circ$; Xylophone $18^\circ$.

Use each frequency as a fraction of the total of 20 students and multiply by $360^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Total number of students:
$$8+5+1+3+2+1=20.$$
Each sector angle is its frequency divided by 20, multiplied by $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Violin angle}&=\frac{8}{20}\times360^\circ=144^\circ\\\text{Cello angle}&=\frac{5}{20}\times360^\circ=90^\circ\\\text{Drums angle}&=\frac{1}{20}\times360^\circ=18^\circ\\\text{Clarinet angle}&=\frac{3}{20}\times360^\circ=54^\circ\\\text{Saxophone angle}&=\frac{2}{20}\times360^\circ=36^\circ\\\text{Xylophone angle}&=\frac{1}{20}\times360^\circ=18^\circ\end{align*}$$
Check:
$$144^\circ+90^\circ+18^\circ+54^\circ+36^\circ+18^\circ=360^\circ.$$
Draw a circle, use a protractor to construct these sectors, and label each instrument.
